Title: Azure Applied AI Services | Azure Cognitive Search updates now generally available

Body.Content: Azure Cognitive Search has expanded language and regional availability. The service is newly available in the Australia East, East US, and South Central US regions. Explore the most recent list of languages supported by Azure Cognitive Search in our documentation.
